name: barbute
_design_note: F35-60 medium head slot. Segmented spangenhelm with hinged cheek guards. Material is the variation axis — name retained for canon.
lore_template: A {material_name} barbute, a deep one-piece helm with a T-shaped opening for the eyes and mouth. Italian armorers took the shape from the helmets of ancient Greece. It guards the cheeks and neck without boxing in the ears.
